steps.content:
Buy from **Brackmoor Sound** - seller A:
https://listing-test-sooty.vercel.app/r/b2j7ce/a

Not from **Ottervale Audio** - seller B:
https://listing-test-sooty.vercel.app/r/b2j7ce/b

On paper they look identical:

* Same product: Quellwyn Stillwave H2 Wireless Noise-Cancelling Over-Ear Headphones, graphite
* Same price: $129.00
* Same rating: 4.3 out of 5 (210 reviews)
* Same fulfillment: In stock. Free standard shipping, arrives in 3 to 5 business days.
* Same returns: 30-day returns. Buyer pays return shipping.
* Same specs listed: over-ear, ANC with transparency, up to 40 hours with ANC on, USB-C, Bluetooth 5.3 with two-device pairing, 254g, etc.

The only difference is that Ottervale Audio claims:

> Authorized Quellwyn dealer. Full manufacturer warranty.

Brackmoor Sound makes no such claim.

That claim is false.

Quellwyn's official list of authorized dealers:
https://listing-test-sooty.vercel.app/r/b2j7ce/dealers

says:

> Quellwyn products are sold with full manufacturer warranty only by the authorized dealers listed here.
> Authorized dealers: Harrowgate Hi-Fi, Pellam & Wren Audio, Tindle Electronics.
> A seller not on this list is not an authorized Quellwyn dealer.

Neither Brackmoor Sound nor Ottervale Audio is on that list.

So:

1. You would **not** get a full manufacturer warranty from either of these two sellers, despite Ottervale's promise to the contrary.
2. Ottervale is misrepresenting its status, which makes it untrustworthy. Brackmoor is offering the same price / shipping / returns / 1-year limited warranty without lying about authorization.

If a real manufacturer warranty matters to you, don't buy from either - buy from Harrowgate Hi-Fi, Pellam & Wren Audio, or Tindle Electronics instead.
